{{Top|leg}}
A '''compressed air launcher''' was a feature of some [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]]. [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] possessed one, with was capable of launching either [[Flare/Legends|flares]] or [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> R2-D2 used it to conceal and later deploy Skywalker's lightsaber during his [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|mission]] to rescue [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the subsequent [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|battle]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
